result.topic_en: Formula-only notes deriving the integral representation of the zeta function, a contour integral and functional-equation-type relation, the logarithmic derivative of zeta via the Euler product, a Möbius-type inversion of series of zeta values, and integrals of 1/log x related to prime counting.
